image_alt: Institute of Retirement — compare countries for retiring abroad.

authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our editorial team collects data on cost of living, healthcare, visa routes, and tax treatments for popular retirement destinations.

editorial.how_we_test: We score countries based on published data regarding cost of living, visa accessibility, healthcare quality, and tax treatment. Our methodology is disclosed in full for every comparison.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We earn modest affiliate commissions and lead generation fees when users engage with our partners. This does not affect our scoring methodology.
editorial.corrections: We correct verifiable factual errors promptly. If you find an error in our data, please contact us.
